# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contains sexually explicit material;
- [x] The problem occurs only when using AdGuard DNS or DNS filtering with AdGuard DNS filter, it is not caused by other ad blockers;
- [x] You're using an up-to-date version of AdGuard DNS filter;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [ ] If a website or an app is broken, disabling AdGuard DNS filter resolves the issue.

### What DNS server do you use?

AdGuard public DNS

### Version

_No response_

### What DNS upstream(s) do you use in AdGuard apps or AdGuard Home?

Android Private DNS (dns.adguard-dns.com) — no AdGuard app, no AdGuard Home

### What DNS filters do you have enabled?

AdGuard DNS filter (default, via public DNS — no custom filters added)

### What browser or app do you use?

Other app

### Which device type do you use?

Mobile

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Missed ads

### Where did you encounter the problem?

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rovio.baba

### Add your comment and screenshots

An ad bypassed AdGuard public DNS filtering in the Android app Angry Birds 2 (com.rovio.baba).

The ad appeared as a full-screen black interstitial. Using Rethink DNS, I can see the connection was made directly to IP 34.160.81.0 (US, Google Cloud) over TCP/443 (HTTPS) — no domain name was used, which is why DNS filtering could not block it.

Device: Samsung Galaxy A36 (Android)
DNS: dns.adguard-dns.com via Android Private DNS (no AdGuard app or AdGuard Home)
Time of incident: approx. 07:00:42

Please consider adding 34.160.81.0 to the IP blocklist.

### Privacy

### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contains sexually explicit material;
- [x] The problem occurs only when using AdGuard DNS or DNS filtering with AdGuard DNS filter, it is not caused by other ad blockers;
- [x] You're using an up-to-date version of AdGuard DNS filter;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [ ] If a website or an app is broken, disabling AdGuard DNS filter resolves the issue.

### What DNS server do you use?

AdGuard public DNS

### Version

_No response_

### What DNS upstream(s) do you use in AdGuard apps or AdGuard Home?

Android Private DNS (dns.adguard-dns.com) — no AdGuard app, no AdGuard Home

### What DNS filters do you have enabled?

AdGuard DNS filter (default, via public DNS — no custom filters added)

### What browser or app do you use?

Other app

### Which device type do you use?

Mobile

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Missed ads

### Where did you encounter the problem?

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rovio.baba

### Add your comment and screenshots

An ad bypassed AdGuard public DNS filtering in the Android app Angry Birds 2 (com.rovio.baba).

The ad appeared as a full-screen black interstitial. Using Rethink DNS, I can see the connection was made directly to IP 34.160.81.0 (US, Google Cloud) over TCP/443 (HTTPS) — no domain name was used, which is why DNS filtering could not block it.

Device: Samsung Galaxy A36 (Android)
DNS: dns.adguard-dns.com via Android Private DNS (no AdGuard app or AdGuard Home)
Time of incident: approx. 07:00:42

Please consider adding 34.160.81.0 to the IP blocklist.

### Privacy

- [x] I agree to follow this condition

- [x] The problem occurs only when using AdGuard DNS or DNS filtering with AdGuard DNS filter, it is not caused by other ad blockers;
- [x] You're using an up-to-date version of AdGuard DNS filter;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [x] If a website or an app is broken, disabling AdGuard DNS filter resolves the issue.

### What DNS server do you use?

AdGuard public DNS

### Version

_No response_

### What DNS upstream(s) do you use in AdGuard apps or AdGuard Home?

_No response_

### What DNS filters do you have enabled?

I am using AdGuard DNS or DNS filtering with AdGuard DNS filter

### What browser or app do you use?

Other app

### Which device type do you use?

Other device

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Missed ads

### Where did you encounter the problem?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots


I tested AdGuard DNS (`dns.adguard-dns.com`) against a comprehensive list of Chinese advertising infrastructure domains. 
**33 domains are confirmed unblocked**, spanning ad SDKs, ad CDNs, ad exchanges, and — critically — **HTTPDNS bypass infrastructure** that Chinese apps use to circumvent DNS-based ad blocking entirely.

---

## Category 1: HTTPDNS Bypass Domains (HIGH PRIORITY)

Chinese apps use HTTPDNS to resolve ad server IPs when regular DNS is blocked. Blocking these domains prevents this evasion technique.

| Domain | SDK / Vendor | Purpose |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `httpdns.volcengineapi.com` | ByteDance / Pangle | Pangle ad SDK HTTPDNS bypass |
| `dns.weixin.qq.com` | Tencent / WeChat | WeChat HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.baidu.com` | Baidu / Baichuan | Baidu ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.baidubce.com` | Baidu Cloud | Baidu Cloud HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.n.netease.com` | NetEase | NetEase ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.meituan.com` | Meituan | Meituan ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.huaweicloud.com` | Huawei Cloud | Huawei ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.browser.miui.com` | Xiaomi / MIUI | Xiaomi browser HTTPDNS bypass |
| `dns.weibo.cn` | Weibo / Sina | Weibo ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `dns.jd.com` | JD.com | JD.com ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.music.163.com` | NetEase Cloud Music | NetEase Cloud Music HTTPDNS bypass |

---

## Category 2: Pangle / ByteDance Ad SDK Core Domains

Confirmed from [Pangle official documentation](https://www.csjplatform.com/supportcenter/5415).

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `i.snssdk.com` | Ad request entry point |
| `is.snssdk.com` | SDK initialization |
| `pangolin.snssdk.com` | Ad serving control |
| `extlog.snssdk.com` | Ad event logging |
| `pangle.cn` | Pangle China site |

---

## Category 3: Pangle / ByteDance Ad CDN Domains

These serve video ad creatives and images.

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `sf6-ttcdn-tos.pstatp.com` | Pangle ad creative CDN |
| `lf3-cdn-tos.bytegoofy.com` | Pangle video ad CDN |

---

## Category 4: Tencent / GDT (广点通/优量汇) Ad Domains

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `qzs.gdtimg.com` | GDT ad creative CDN |
| `tangram.qq.com` | Tencent ad delivery platform |
| `x.adnet.qq.com` | Tencent ad network |

---

## Category 5: Alibaba / Alimama Ad Exchange

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `tanx.com` | Alimama ad exchange (root) |
| `a.tanx.com` | Ad serving endpoint |
| `cdn.tanx.com` | Ad creative CDN |
| `acs.m.taobao.com` | Mobile Taobao ad service |
| `adashx.m.taobao.com` | Taobao ad tracking |

---

## Category 6: DCloud / uni-app Ad SDK

Used by thousands of Chinese mini-apps built on the uni-app framework.

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `uniad.dcloud.net.cn` | uni-ad advertising platform |
| `dcloud.io` | DCloud ad integration |

---

## Category 7: Other Ad SDKs

| Domain | Vendor |
|--------|--------|
| `sigmob.com` | Sigmob ad SDK |
| `admobile.top` | Ad SDK / mediation |
| `ad.xiaohongshu.com` | Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) ads |

---

All domains were tested using:

adb shell ping -c 1 -W 1 <domain> 2>/dev/null | grep "from"

issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contains sexually explicit material;
- [x] The problem occurs only when using AdGuard DNS or DNS filtering with AdGuard DNS filter, it is not caused by other ad blockers;
- [x] You're using an up-to-date version of AdGuard DNS filter;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [ ] If a website or an app is broken, disabling AdGuard DNS filter resolves the issue.

### What DNS server do you use?

AdGuard public DNS

### Version

_No response_

### What DNS upstream(s) do you use in AdGuard apps or AdGuard Home?

Android Private DNS (dns.adguard-dns.com) — no AdGuard app, no AdGuard Home

### What DNS filters do you have enabled?

AdGuard DNS filter (default, via public DNS — no custom filters added)

### What browser or app do you use?

Other app

### Which device type do you use?

Mobile

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Missed ads

### Where did you encounter the problem?

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rovio.baba

### Add your comment and screenshots

An ad bypassed AdGuard public DNS filtering in the Android app Angry Birds 2 (com.rovio.baba).

The ad appeared as a full-screen black interstitial. Using Rethink DNS, I can see the connection was made directly to IP 34.160.81.0 (US, Google Cloud) over TCP/443 (HTTPS) — no domain name was used, which is why DNS filtering could not block it.

Device: Samsung Galaxy A36 (Android)
DNS: dns.adguard-dns.com via Android Private DNS (no AdGuard app or AdGuard Home)
Time of incident: approx. 07:00:42

Please consider adding 34.160.81.0 to the IP blocklist.

### Privacy

- [x] I agree to follow this condition

comment.body: Hi thank you for responding. Unfortunately from what I could tell the ads came from direct ip addresses that bypassed adguard dns. To reproduce ads simply play angry birds 2 with the dns on. It might take some time as I cannot predict exactly when an ad might happen in the game but it was not by trying to get a reward by watching ads, it was in in btwn levels like I imagine there would normally be ads if I was not using adguard dns at all.

labels.name: A: Bug
labels.description: The issue is caused by an ad blocker bug

labels.name: A: In progress
labels.description: Work on the issue is in progress

issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] The problem occurs only when using AdGuard DNS or DNS filtering with AdGuard DNS filter, it is not caused by other ad blockers;
- [x] You're using an up-to-date version of AdGuard DNS filter;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [x] If a website or an app is broken, disabling AdGuard DNS filter resolves the issue.

### What DNS server do you use?

AdGuard public DNS

### Version

_No response_

### What DNS upstream(s) do you use in AdGuard apps or AdGuard Home?

_No response_

### What DNS filters do you have enabled?

I am using AdGuard DNS or DNS filtering with AdGuard DNS filter

### What browser or app do you use?

Other app

### Which device type do you use?

Other device

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Missed ads

### Where did you encounter the problem?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots


I tested AdGuard DNS (`dns.adguard-dns.com`) against a comprehensive list of Chinese advertising infrastructure domains. 
**33 domains are confirmed unblocked**, spanning ad SDKs, ad CDNs, ad exchanges, and — critically — **HTTPDNS bypass infrastructure** that Chinese apps use to circumvent DNS-based ad blocking entirely.

---

## Category 1: HTTPDNS Bypass Domains (HIGH PRIORITY)

Chinese apps use HTTPDNS to resolve ad server IPs when regular DNS is blocked. Blocking these domains prevents this evasion technique.

| Domain | SDK / Vendor | Purpose |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `httpdns.volcengineapi.com` | ByteDance / Pangle | Pangle ad SDK HTTPDNS bypass |
| `dns.weixin.qq.com` | Tencent / WeChat | WeChat HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.baidu.com` | Baidu / Baichuan | Baidu ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.baidubce.com` | Baidu Cloud | Baidu Cloud HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.n.netease.com` | NetEase | NetEase ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.meituan.com` | Meituan | Meituan ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.huaweicloud.com` | Huawei Cloud | Huawei ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.browser.miui.com` | Xiaomi / MIUI | Xiaomi browser HTTPDNS bypass |
| `dns.weibo.cn` | Weibo / Sina | Weibo ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `dns.jd.com` | JD.com | JD.com ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.music.163.com` | NetEase Cloud Music | NetEase Cloud Music HTTPDNS bypass |

---

## Category 2: Pangle / ByteDance Ad SDK Core Domains

Confirmed from [Pangle official documentation](https://www.csjplatform.com/supportcenter/5415).

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `i.snssdk.com` | Ad request entry point |
| `is.snssdk.com` | SDK initialization |
| `pangolin.snssdk.com` | Ad serving control |
| `extlog.snssdk.com` | Ad event logging |
| `pangle.cn` | Pangle China site |

---

## Category 3: Pangle / ByteDance Ad CDN Domains

These serve video ad creatives and images.

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `sf6-ttcdn-tos.pstatp.com` | Pangle ad creative CDN |
| `lf3-cdn-tos.bytegoofy.com` | Pangle video ad CDN |

---

## Category 4: Tencent / GDT (广点通/优量汇) Ad Domains

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `qzs.gdtimg.com` | GDT ad creative CDN |
| `tangram.qq.com` | Tencent ad delivery platform |
| `x.adnet.qq.com` | Tencent ad network |

---

## Category 5: Alibaba / Alimama Ad Exchange

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `tanx.com` | Alimama ad exchange (root) |
| `a.tanx.com` | Ad serving endpoint |
| `cdn.tanx.com` | Ad creative CDN |
| `acs.m.taobao.com` | Mobile Taobao ad service |
| `adashx.m.taobao.com` | Taobao ad tracking |

---

## Category 6: DCloud / uni-app Ad SDK

Used by thousands of Chinese mini-apps built on the uni-app framework.

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `uniad.dcloud.net.cn` | uni-ad advertising platform |
| `dcloud.io` | DCloud ad integration |

---

## Category 7: Other Ad SDKs

| Domain | Vendor |
|--------|--------|
| `sigmob.com` | Sigmob ad SDK |
| `admobile.top` | Ad SDK / mediation |
| `ad.xiaohongshu.com` | Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) ads |

---

All domains were tested using:

issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] The problem occurs only when using AdGuard DNS or DNS filtering with AdGuard DNS filter, it is not caused by other ad blockers;
- [x] You're using an up-to-date version of AdGuard DNS filter;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [x] If a website or an app is broken, disabling AdGuard DNS filter resolves the issue.

### What DNS server do you use?

AdGuard public DNS

### Version

### What DNS upstream(s) do you use in AdGuard apps or AdGuard Home?

### What DNS filters do you have enabled?

I am using AdGuard DNS or DNS filtering with AdGuard DNS filter

### What browser or app do you use?

Other app

### Which device type do you use?

Other device

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Missed ads

### Where did you encounter the problem?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots


I tested AdGuard DNS (`dns.adguard-dns.com`) against a comprehensive list of Chinese advertising infrastructure domains. 
**33 domains are confirmed unblocked**, spanning ad SDKs, ad CDNs, ad exchanges, and — critically — **HTTPDNS bypass infrastructure** that Chinese apps use to circumvent DNS-based ad blocking entirely.

---

## Category 1: HTTPDNS Bypass Domains (HIGH PRIORITY)

Chinese apps use HTTPDNS to resolve ad server IPs when regular DNS is blocked. Blocking these domains prevents this evasion technique.

| Domain | SDK / Vendor | Purpose |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `httpdns.volcengineapi.com` | ByteDance / Pangle | Pangle ad SDK HTTPDNS bypass |
| `dns.weixin.qq.com` | Tencent / WeChat | WeChat HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.baidu.com` | Baidu / Baichuan | Baidu ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.baidubce.com` | Baidu Cloud | Baidu Cloud HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.n.netease.com` | NetEase | NetEase ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.meituan.com` | Meituan | Meituan ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.huaweicloud.com` | Huawei Cloud | Huawei ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.browser.miui.com` | Xiaomi / MIUI | Xiaomi browser HTTPDNS bypass |
| `dns.weibo.cn` | Weibo / Sina | Weibo ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `dns.jd.com` | JD.com | JD.com ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.music.163.com` | NetEase Cloud Music | NetEase Cloud Music HTTPDNS bypass |

---

## Category 2: Pangle / ByteDance Ad SDK Core Domains

Confirmed from [Pangle official documentation](https://www.csjplatform.com/supportcenter/5415).

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `i.snssdk.com` | Ad request entry point |
| `is.snssdk.com` | SDK initialization |
| `pangolin.snssdk.com` | Ad serving control |
| `extlog.snssdk.com` | Ad event logging |
| `pangle.cn` | Pangle China site |

---

## Category 3: Pangle / ByteDance Ad CDN Domains

These serve video ad creatives and images.

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `sf6-ttcdn-tos.pstatp.com` | Pangle ad creative CDN |
| `lf3-cdn-tos.bytegoofy.com` | Pangle video ad CDN |

---

## Category 4: Tencent / GDT (广点通/优量汇) Ad Domains

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `qzs.gdtimg.com` | GDT ad creative CDN |
| `tangram.qq.com` | Tencent ad delivery platform |
| `x.adnet.qq.com` | Tencent ad network |

---

## Category 5: Alibaba / Alimama Ad Exchange

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `tanx.com` | Alimama ad exchange (root) |
| `a.tanx.com` | Ad serving endpoint |
| `cdn.tanx.com` | Ad creative CDN |
| `acs.m.taobao.com` | Mobile Taobao ad service |
| `adashx.m.taobao.com` | Taobao ad tracking |

---

## Category 6: DCloud / uni-app Ad SDK

Used by thousands of Chinese mini-apps built on the uni-app framework.

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `uniad.dcloud.net.cn` | uni-ad advertising platform |
| `dcloud.io` | DCloud ad integration |

---

## Category 7: Other Ad SDKs

| Domain | Vendor |
|--------|--------|
| `sigmob.com` | Sigmob ad SDK |
| `admobile.top` | Ad SDK / mediation |
| `ad.xiaohongshu.com` | Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) ads |

---

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

# 죄송합니다. Umanle S.R.L.가 AdGuard의 광고 차단을 방해하고 있습니다.

나무위키 운영사인 Umanle S.R.L.가 나무위키의 DOM 구조를 관련된 필터 업데이트가 있을 때 마다 변경하므로 필터로 차단하기에는 오차단이 발생할 수 있습니다.

또한, Umanle S.R.L.가 기술적인 안티-애드블록하여 의도적으로 나무위키 문서를 읽을 수 없게 했던 점과 전용 유저스크립트인 NamuLink의 차단 방법을 우회하게끔 네이버 파워링크 광고 알고리즘을 업데이트합니다.

## 유저스크립트 설치

[NamuLink 유저스크립트](https://github.com/List-KR/NamuLink)를 설치하여 나무위키의 파워링크 광고를 차단하실 수 있습니다.
한국어로 작성되어 있는 설치 방법은 [이 URL](https://community.list-kr.com/docs/AdGuard/Userscripts/NamuLink)를 클릭하여 확인해주세요.


## 그래도 문제가 있으신가요?
유저스크립트를 사용했을 때 발생하는 문제는 [이 이슈 트래커](https://github.com/List-KR/NamuLink/issues)로 알려주세요.
기타 문제는 [이 곳](https://github.com/List-KR/List-KR/issues)으로 알려주세요.
GitHub 이슈를 사용하시기 어렵다면, filters@adguard.com 로 문의해주세요.
